newsitem.title: USA: Washington Mutual holders OK merger.
newsitem.headline: Washington Mutual holders OK merger.

text.p: Washington Mutual Inc Wednesday said the company's shareholders approved the merger of Washington Mutual and Keystone Holdings Inc.
As part of the transaction, Washington Mutual will acquire Keystone's primary subsidiary, American Savings Bank, based in Irvine, Calif.
Based on September 30, 1996, financial figures, the combined company would have assets exceeding $43 billion.
The transaction has been approved by the Office of Thrift Supervision and is expected to be completed Friday.

Shareholders also voted to amend the company's articles of incorporation to increase the number of authorized common shares to 350 million. A portion of the shares will be issued to the partners who own Keystone Holdings Inc. and to the FDIC, in its capacity as manager of the FSLIC Resolution Fund.
